core_meaning.primary_meaning: Alzahra corresponds to the Arabic form الزهراء and is glossed in this record as “The radiant, the luminous.” The lexical gloss describes the word-form; Qur’anic occurrence, religious recommendation, popularity, and a name-bearer’s character are separate claims and are not established by this gloss alone.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Alzahra corresponds to the Arabic form الزهراء (ز ه ر). Its core sense is the radiant, the luminous (al-zahrāʾ). Al-Zahrāʾ ('the radiant, the luminous'), the epithet of Fāṭima, daughter of the Prophet Muhammad. The source record's gloss 'The Flowering One' is an approximation.

arabic.name: الزهراء
arabic.long_meaning: Alzahra (الزهراء) اسم مأخوذ من اللغة العربية، ومعناه الأساسي الزهراء، المشرقة. يُستخدم هذا الاسم في المجتمعات المسلمة ويختلف استعماله بحسب السياق اللغوي.
